passages.quote: They also want to increase the current top two tax brackets by one percentage point. passages.title: Emily Lowan's BC Greens promise to bring back vacancy control (Daily Hive)
passages.quote: Following the publication of this article, the BC NDP reached out to Daily Hive Urbanized with a statement from Nina Krieger, BC NDP candidate for Victoria-Swan Lake and the Minister of Public Safety. “We agree that action is critical, that’s why we are protecting renters and creating more housing to bring down the cost of rent,” she said. The BC NDP said that they had protected more than 2,000 affordable rentals with the Rental Protection Fund and capped rent increases at inflation for the past seven years. Krieger added that the BC NDP has introduced the promise of a new tax on unsold condos , as well as increasing the provincial government’s existing Speculation and Vacancy Tax.

passages.title: Lowan Calls for Bold Tax Reform (Ultra-Wealthy Fairness Tax)
passages.quote: Introduce a Land Value Tax By replacing the existing property tax system with a Land Value Tax on vacant, residential, and commercial land, with tax breaks for low- to middle-income households and senior home-owners at risk of displacement. An LVT system would encourage efficient land use, reduce speculation and sprawl, and reduce wealth inequality. The Property Tax Deferral Program currently costs the province over $2.13 billion. Many of B.C.’s wealthiest landowners, including those living on Vancouver’s so-called “Billionaire’s Row,” are legally avoiding property taxes on homes worth tens of millions of dollars.
